NIA. tends to keep MIA. chadd- (< chárdati) and chaṇḍ- (< *chr̥ndati) as 'vomit', chaḍḍ- (< chárdati) as 'leave', but not exclusively. Derivation of Pk. chaḍḍēi < tyakta- Tedesco OrLit 1932 col. 527 phonet. impossible and semant. unnecessary. — √chr̥d]
